remaining_before_physical_test: Select the target GPIO/PWM controller, output line, active polarity, and hardware watchdog/relay wiring.
Implement an opt-in physical backend while retaining simulation as the default.
Measure the hold signal with a logic analyzer under CPU and I/O load.
Remove executor heartbeats and verify relay power loss within 100 ms.
SIGKILL the safety monitor and verify hardware dead-man power loss without software assistance.
Repeat fault injection and record raw timestamps, signal traces, relay voltage, and pass/fail results.
claim: Physical safety is unverified; no hardware safety claim is made.
